## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Vajrabodhi** ([金剛智](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%87%91%E5%89%9B%E6%99%BA)) for the practice of **Bhaiṣajyaguru** (藥師如來 *Yàoshī rúlái* — the "Medicine-Master Tathāgata") — the popular Mahāyāna healing-Buddha presiding over the eastern Pure Land of *Vaiḍūryanirbhāsa* (淨琉璃淨土 *Jìngliúlí jìngtǔ*). The Bhaiṣajyaguru cult was one of the most popular Buddhist devotional traditions in East Asia, particularly for healing and protection.

**Abstract**

The text gives an Esoteric *sādhana* for Bhaiṣajyaguru: the *mudrā*-mantra-visualisation triplets, the offering sequences, the *japa* of the Bhaiṣajyaguru *dhāraṇī*, and the merit-dedication. The integration of the popular Bhaiṣajyaguru cult with the Esoteric ritual framework is one of Vajrabodhi's contributions to the systematisation of Tang Buddhist devotional practice.

The translation dates from Vajrabodhi's Chángān period (720–741).
